description: Solve different screw puzzles in different difficulties from easy to hard and choose from over 100 puzzles. Loosen different shapes from rings to complicated structures and loosen each screw to expose the beams. Attention, the order is crucial! But don't worry, various boosters will help you if you get stuck! Grab your screwdriver and get started!
name: Losen Screws Puzzles
intro: Solve over 100 tricky screw puzzles und unsrew them all!
